summary: Southport Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting consummation of its $210M IPO on October 2, 2026: 21,000,000 units at $10.00, including a 1,000,000-unit partial over-allotment exercise. Concurrently, 770,000 private placement units were sold at $10.00 to sponsor Southport Acquisition Sponsor II LLC (500,000) and underwriter representative Cohen & Company Capital Markets (270,000), raising $7.7M. Gross proceeds of $212.1M, or $10.10 per unit, were deposited into a Continental Stock Transfer & Trust trust account. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-half warrant exercisable at $11.50; NYSE symbols PORT.U, PORT, PORT.W. Watch trust yield, deal-sourcing timeline, and the 24-month completion runway.
